text: A reputation scoring system that does not name its resistance to Sybil creation, collusion, wash interaction, and cross-context reputation laundering has not specified a threat model.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7314479

isBasedOn.name: Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes

abstract: Sybil creation, collusion, wash interaction, and reputation laundering across contexts are the standard attacks, and a scoring system that does not name its resistance to each of them has not specified a threat model.
